core.name: Stortorget
core.why: Malmö's 1530s main square with the town hall and Karl X Gustav statue, the city's reference point.

core.name: Lilla Torg
core.why: The half-timbered square of outdoor dining that every Malmö resident knows and meets at.

core.name: Gustav Adolfs torg
core.why: Central square on the main shopping axis and a major bus stop; 'vid Gustav Adolfs torg' is everyday direction-giving.

core.name: Möllevångstorget
core.why: Möllan: daily market, Arbetets ära monument, the heart of Möllevången nightlife.

core.name: Drottningtorget
core.why: Large square on the northeast edge of the old town by Caroli, a well-known landmark and bus stop.
evidence: sources: visitmalmo: se och göra, wikipedia

core.name: Värnhemstorget
core.why: Major bus interchange and market square east of the centre.

core.name: Davidshallstorg
core.why: Square at the heart of the Davidshall quarter, a common meeting point with cafés and restaurants.

core.name: Nobeltorget
core.why: Busy junction square between Möllevången, Sofielund and Rosengård with a well-known bus stop.

core.name: Dalaplan
core.why: Large traffic square and bus hub on the south side of the inner city that everyone uses as a landmark; currently being rebuilt as a proper square.

core.name: Fridhemstorget
core.why: Market square and bus stop on the west side, the everyday meeting point for Fridhem/Västra Innerstaden.

core.name: Sankt Knuts torg
core.why: Large square between Möllevången and Sofielund with a well-known bus stop, commonly used for directions.
evidence: hemnet uses 'S:t Knuts torg' as an area name

drop.name: LOVE Malmö
drop.why: an art installation/photo spot, not a square

drop.name: Sagas Gränds Torg
drop.why: tiny courtyard node in Hyllie, trivial

drop.name: Hermods Plats
drop.why: small local plaza in Bunkeflostrand, trivial

drop.name: Spiggans plats
drop.why: small pocket space near Spårvägsmuseet, nobody calls it a square

drop.name: Nils Forsbergs plats
drop.why: small named spot, not known as a square

drop.name: R F Bergs plats
drop.why: small named spot in Limhamn, not known as a square

drop.name: Sockerbitstorget
drop.why: Arlöv (Burlöv) local square, not widely known by Malmö residents

drop.name: Ola Billgrens plats
drop.why: small recently named spot, not known as a square

missing.name: Triangeln
missing.why: The square at Triangeln (Södra Förstadsgatan, by S:t Johannes kyrka and the station/mall) is listed by malmo.se among Malmö's squares ('Triangeltorget'); tagged highway=pedestrian so it fell out of the list.

missing.name: Södervärn
missing.why: Bus-hub square south of the centre, already in the game as a square (landmarks.json); only the bus station is mapped, no square polygon.

missing.name: Anna Lindhs plats
missing.why: Pedestrian square by Malmö C/Hamnkanalen with its own sv Wikipedia article (Q10412357) and bus stop; tagged highway=pedestrian.

missing.name: Södertull
missing.why: Listed by malmo.se among Malmö's squares: the piazzas between Gustav Adolfs torg and the canal at Davidshallsbron; not named in OSM, coordinates approximate.

missing.name: Centralplan
missing.why: The forecourt in front of Malmö C; mapped only as bus service roads. People say 'Centralen' rather than Centralplan, so probably better covered by the station.

missing.name: Scaniaplatsen
missing.why: Large waterside plaza in Västra Hamnen by Turning Torso; tagged area:highway=pedestrian.

notes: Core = 11 from the list plus Triangeln and Södervärn from missing (13 total). Fewer than 15 because beyond these the squares are neighbourhood-level. Borderline core calls for the owner: Limhamns torg (centre of Limhamn, well known locally but less city-wide), Kirsebergs torg (malmo.se sommartorg 2026), Anna Lindhs plats (by Malmö C, but people say 'Centralen'). Fridhemstorget and Sankt Knuts torg are medium: well-known bus stops/market squares, weaker guide signals. Stortorget's Wikidata item (Q8711309, 8 sitelinks) sits in _unmatched wikidataOnly; it should be linked to the OSM Stortorget. Triangeln is also a station (Triangelns station) and mall; if the game has it as a station, the square question may be redundant. Södervärn is already in landmarks.json as a square but has no square geometry in OSM, only the bus station node. Dalaplan is under reconstruction into a real square; it stays a landmark either way. Västra Hamnen plazas (Dockplatsen, Masttorget, Kockums torg, plus Scaniaplatsen in missing and Stapelplatsen relation/4663162 not added) have low recognition.
